Brown Butter Shortbread.paprikarecipe.directions:
Brown the butter in a pale pan until it smells of hazelnuts, then cool until thick.
Beat in the sugar, then the flour and salt, to a stiff paste.
Press into a tin, dock all over, and bake at 325F for 40 minutes.
Cut while warm and cool in the tin.
Brown Butter Shortbread.paprikarecipe.ingredients:
14 tablespoons/200g butter
1/2 cup/100g caster sugar
2 cups/250g plain flour
1/4 teaspoon/1.5g fine salt
Brown Butter Shortbread.paprikarecipe.name: Brown Butter Shortbread

Buttermilk Scones.paprikarecipe.directions:
Heat the oven to 425F. Line a tray with parchment.
Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder and salt until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the buttermilk until a shaggy dough forms. Do not overwork it.
Pat out to 1 inch thick, cut rounds, and bake for 12 to 14 minutes.
Buttermilk Scones.paprikarecipe.ingredients:
2 cups/250g plain flour
1 tablespoon/12g baking powder
1/2 teaspoon/3g fine salt
5 tablespoons/70g cold butter, cubed
3/4 cup/180ml buttermilk
Buttermilk Scones.paprikarecipe.name: Buttermilk Scones
